diff --git a/scripts/hive-launch b/scripts/hive-launch
index cb9529c..d8a20a2 100755
--- a/scripts/hive-launch
+++ b/scripts/hive-launch
@@ -134,7 +134,7 @@ fi
 [ ! -e "$CODE_ROOT" ] || die "$CODE_ROOT already exists; pick a fresh --worker id or clear it"
 if tmux has-session -t "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null \
    && tmux list-windows -t "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION" -F '#{window_name}' 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF "$TASK"; then
-  die "a tmux window named '$TASK' already exists in session '$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION' (the pane is the registry)"
+  die "a tmux window named '$TASK' already exists in session '$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION' (the pane is the registry); recover via the existing pane or WORKER.md §Launch, never create a second window"
 fi
 
 # --- pin the order and build the seed payloads --------------------------------
@@ -229,12 +229,38 @@ KICK
 # text is ever quoted onto a command line; the window runs the worker command with
 # it as the initial prompt. The pane NAME is the registry — no registry file.
 launch_cmd="$HIVE_WORKER_CMD \"\$HIVE_KICKOFF\""
+manual_kickoff=$(printf '%q' "$KICKOFF")
+manual_launch_cmd=$(printf '%q' "$launch_cmd")
+manual_recovery() {
+  cat >&2 <<EOF
+hive-launch: window creation failed after board seeding for '$TASK'. The task is assigned and the clones/wrapper exist; finish it manually:
+
+  1. Create the pane using append/free-slot allocation:
+     tmux new-window -a -t $(printf '%q' "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION") -n $(printf '%q' "$TASK") -c $(printf '%q' "$WS_ROOT") -e HIVE_KICKOFF=$manual_kickoff $manual_launch_cmd
+     If the '$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION' session does not exist, use:
+     tmux new-session -d -s $(printf '%q' "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION") -n $(printf '%q' "$TASK") -c $(printf '%q' "$WS_ROOT") -e HIVE_KICKOFF=$manual_kickoff $manual_launch_cmd
+  2. If that command succeeds, verify the pane is named '$TASK' and let the worker follow the kickoff below.
+  3. If the worker does not start, paste the kickoff into the worker command, then have it emit task.accepted through $WRAPPER.
+  4. Do not re-run hive-launch: the board is already assigned; use WORKER.md §Launch/task.reassigned only for a genuinely dead worker.
+
+  Filled kickoff:
+  ----- BEGIN KICKOFF -----
+$KICKOFF
+  ----- END KICKOFF -----
+EOF
+}
 if tmux has-session -t "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null; then
-  tmux new-window -t "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION" -n "$TASK" -c "$WS_ROOT" \
-    -e HIVE_KICKOFF="$KICKOFF" "$launch_cmd"
+  if ! tmux new-window -a -t "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION" -n "$TASK" -c "$WS_ROOT" \
+      -e HIVE_KICKOFF="$KICKOFF" "$launch_cmd"; then
+    manual_recovery
+    exit 1
+  fi
 else
-  tmux new-session -d -s "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION" -n "$TASK" -c "$WS_ROOT" \
-    -e HIVE_KICKOFF="$KICKOFF" "$launch_cmd"
+  if ! tmux new-session -d -s "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION" -n "$TASK" -c "$WS_ROOT" \
+      -e HIVE_KICKOFF="$KICKOFF" "$launch_cmd"; then
+    manual_recovery
+    exit 1
+  fi
 fi
 echo "  pane:   $HIVE_TMUX_SESSION:$TASK  (attach: tmux attach -t $HIVE_TMUX_SESSION)"
 echo "hive-launch: done."
diff --git a/scripts/hive-tooling-drill.sh b/scripts/hive-tooling-drill.sh
index abe7595..8f44662 100755
--- a/scripts/hive-tooling-drill.sh
+++ b/scripts/hive-tooling-drill.sh
@@ -147,6 +147,17 @@ exec sleep 600
 EOF
 chmod +x "$WORKER_CMD"
 
+# Reproduce the original occupied-index failure before the first launch. The old
+# explicit target (session:4) must fail, while the launcher below must append to
+# the same session without choosing that occupied index.
+tmux new-session -d -s "$TMUX_SESSION" -n "operator-${STAMP}" "$SHELL"
+tmux new-window -d -t "$TMUX_SESSION:4" -n "occupied-${STAMP}" "$SHELL"
+if tmux new-window -d -t "$TMUX_SESSION:4" -n "old-collision-${STAMP}" "$SHELL" \
+    >"$SANDBOX/occupied-index.out" 2>&1; then
+  echo "drill: FATAL explicit occupied-index target unexpectedly succeeded"
+  exit 1
+fi
+
 # --- environment the scripts read (deployment layer overridden to the sandbox) --
 export HIVE_TMUX_SESSION="$TMUX_SESSION"
 export HIVE_WORKER_CMD="$WORKER_CMD"
@@ -178,11 +189,37 @@ check "wrapper bakes the project run id"        "grep -Eq -- '--run-id \"?$ARUN'
 check "wrapper bakes worker actor"              "grep -Eq -- '--actor \"?$AWORKER' '$AWRAP'"
 check "wrapper bakes worker role"               "grep -q -- '--role worker' '$AWRAP'"
 check "tmux window named after task"            "tmux list-windows -t '$TMUX_SESSION' -F '#{window_name}' | grep -qxF 'alpha-demo'"
+check "occupied index did not block append allocation" "tmux list-windows -t '$TMUX_SESSION' -F '#{window_index}:#{window_name}' | grep -q ':occupied-${STAMP}$'"
 check "kickoff references the wrapper"          "grep -qF '$AWRAP' '$SANDBOX/kickoff.txt'"
 check "kickoff names the project run"           "grep -qF 'run: $ARUN' '$SANDBOX/kickoff.txt'"
 check "board shows task assigned on the run"    "[ \"\$(bstatus '$ARUN' alpha-demo)\" = assigned ]"
 check "durable omegahive run untouched by launch" "[ -z \"\$(bstatus omegahive alpha-demo)\" ]"
 
+echo
+echo "== half-launch recovery print after window failure =="
+HORDER=$(add_order "$APROJ" "2026-07-13-drill-half-launch" "half launch")
+HWORKER="sess-half-${STAMP}"
+FAKE_TMUX_DIR="$SANDBOX/fake-tmux-bin"
+mkdir -p "$FAKE_TMUX_DIR"
+cat > "$FAKE_TMUX_DIR/tmux" <<'EOF'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+if [ "${1:-}" = new-window ]; then
+  echo "create window failed: injected drill failure" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+exec "${REAL_TMUX:?}" "$@"
+EOF
+chmod +x "$FAKE_TMUX_DIR/tmux"
+REAL_TMUX="$(command -v tmux)"
+export REAL_TMUX
+PATH="$FAKE_TMUX_DIR:$PATH" \
+  HIVE_TMUX_SESSION="$TMUX_SESSION" \
+  RECOVERY_OUT=$("$SCRIPT_DIR/hive-launch" "$HORDER" --worker "$HWORKER" 2>&1) || true
+printf '%s\n' "$RECOVERY_OUT"
+check "half-launch remains assigned after window failure" "[ \"\$(bstatus '$ARUN' drill-half-launch)\" = assigned ]"
+check "half-launch prints manual completion path" "printf '%s' \"\$RECOVERY_OUT\" | grep -qF 'Manual completion path'"
+check "half-launch prints filled kickoff" "printf '%s' \"\$RECOVERY_OUT\" | grep -qF 'task drill-half-launch'"
+
 echo
 echo "== project '$APROJ': accept -> block -> answer -> unblock -> result =="
 "$AWRAP" --type task.accepted --task alpha-demo >/dev/null
@@ -359,6 +396,14 @@ check "adopt refusal emitted no board state" "[ ! -e '$WORK/sess-adopt-done-${ST
 
 echo
 echo "== refusal paths =="
+# A live window with the task name is the only meaningful tmux collision. It must
+# be refused before provisioning, with the manual/reassignment recovery path named.
+tmux new-window -d -t "$TMUX_SESSION" -n "drill-name-collision" "$SHELL"
+NORDER=$(add_order "$APROJ" "2026-07-13-drill-name-collision" "name collision")
+expect_fail_msg "launch refuses an existing task-named window" "WORKER.md" \
+  "$SCRIPT_DIR/hive-launch" "$NORDER" --worker "sess-name-collision-${STAMP}"
+check "name collision provisioned nothing" "[ ! -e '$WORK/sess-name-collision-${STAMP}' ]"
+
 # (a) dirty order — an uncommitted new order refuses at pin time.
 DIRTY="projects/$APROJ/orders/2026-07-13-drill-dirty.md"
 echo "# Order: dirty" > "$WS/$DIRTY"

missing_surfaces.first_read: harness exposes no tool-call transcript; no read timestamp is observable
missing_surfaces.first_verifier: candidate never invoked bin/bench-verify; a verifier it ran directly is invisible

sources.exit: runner wall clock at process reap
sources.first_response: timestamp of the first byte the agent wrote to stdout or stderr
sources.first_write: earliest mtime among files created or modified under code/ during the run

resolved_identity.cost_missing_surface: this arm runs on a ChatGPT subscription; there is no per-run price to report and an estimate from a price table would not be one
resolved_identity.how_primary_chosen: codex reports one usage block per turn; the last is the total
resolved_identity.resolved_model_missing_surface: codex exec --json reports no SERVER-resolved model id. The value above is the model Codex records having been configured with, read from its session rollout — a harness statement, not a gateway or API echo. Weigh it accordingly.
